items.t: Crankshaft pulley bolt breaks or loosens
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley (harmonic balancer) and bolt
items.note: If the crankshaft keyway or nose is damaged, the repair costs much more.

items.job: Tighten or replace crank pulley bolt (recall 00V311001)
items.note: Free at a Mitsubishi dealer if the recall was never done.

items.job: Replace hydraulic brake booster / ABS hydraulic unit
items.note: Priced from RepairPal's ABS control module estimate for these years; the booster pump and accumulator are part of the same hydraulic system.

items.t: Front-end vibration and worn steering parts
items.job: Replace front control arm with bushings and ball joint
items.note: Tie rods or wheel bearings may be the worn part instead. Add an alignment.

items.t: Timing belt, tensioner or idler failure
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and idler
items.note: If the belt broke on an interference engine, valve repairs add a lot.

items.t: Warped rotors and fast brake pad wear
4WD, transfer case or ABS lights flashing
items.note: Often a wheel speed sensor or transfer case actuator is the fault instead, which costs less.
